    @classmethod
    def from_openai(cls, u: Any) -> Usage:
        """Build from an OpenAI-shaped usage object, treating missing/None counts as 0."""
        return cls(**{k: getattr(u, k, 0) or 0 for k in ("prompt_tokens", "completion_tokens", "total_tokens")})

def _custom_provider_runtime_ids(value: Any) -> set[str]:
    """Return raw/menu identities that runtime accepts for a configured name."""

    ``aiohttp.ClientSession``s honor HTTP(S)_PROXY / NO_PROXY / SSL_CERT_FILE. Set false

def _norm_url(url: Any) -> str:
    # Effective base URLs of every built-in row we emit (normalized lower+rstrip). Section 4 uses this to
    # hide ``custom_providers`` entries that point at the same endpoint as a built-in (e.g. a user-defined
    # "my-dashscope" on https://coding-intl.dashscope.aliyuncs.com/v1 collides with the built-in
    # alibaba-coding-plan row when DASHSCOPE_API_KEY is present). Fixes #16970.
    return str(url or "").strip().rstrip("/").lower()

    url = f"{API_BASE_URL.rstrip('/')}/{path.lstrip('/')}"
    with httpx.Client(timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT, headers=_headers()) as client:
        response = client.request(method, url, params=params)

        return response.json()

Root cause: asyncio.run() creates and *closes* a fresh event loop on every
call.  Cached httpx/AsyncOpenAI clients that were bound to the now-dead loop

The fix replaces asyncio.run() with a persistent event loop in _run_async().

def _get_json(url: str, headers: dict[str, str], *, timeout: float) -> dict:

def _norm_url(url: Any) -> str:
    # Effective base URLs of every built-in row we emit (normalized lower+rstrip). Section 4 uses this to
    # hide ``custom_providers`` entries that point at the same endpoint as a built-in (e.g. a user-defined
    # "my-dashscope" on https://coding-intl.dashscope.aliyuncs.com/v1 collides with the built-in
    # alibaba-coding-plan row when DASHSCOPE_API_KEY is present). Fixes #16970.
    return str(url or "").strip().rstrip("/").lower()
